stories.name_fr: Réductions de coûts visées à mi-2028
stories.name_en: Cost reduction synergies targeted by mid-2028
stories.story_fr: Omnicom vise 1,5 Md$ de réductions de coûts d’ici mi-2028, dont 0,9 Md$ en 2026 et 1,3 Md$ en 2027.
stories.story_en: Omnicom targets $1.5 billion of cost reductions by mid-2028, including $0.9 billion in 2026 and $1.3 billion in 2027.
stories.citation: Our synergy expectation is to achieve $1.5 billion in cost reductions by mid-2028

stories.explanation: Programme approuvé par le conseil d’administration.
stories.story_fr: Le conseil d’administration d’Omnicom a approuvé un programme de rachat d’actions de 5 Mds$.
stories.story_en: Omnicom's board approved a $5 billion share repurchase program.
stories.citation: our board of directors approved a $5 billion share repurchase program

stories.explanation: Part du programme de 5 Mds $ prévue sur l’exercice.
stories.story_fr: Omnicom prévoit de racheter pour 3 à 3,5 Mds$ d’actions en 2026.
stories.story_en: Omnicom plans to repurchase $3 billion to $3.5 billion of shares during 2026.
stories.citation: We plan to repurchase $3 billion to $3.5 billion of shares during 2026

stories.explanation: Plus grand acheteur de médias après l’acquisition d’Interpublic.
stories.story_fr: Omnicom gère plus de 70 Mds$ d’investissement média par an.
stories.story_en: Omnicom now manages more than $70 billion in annual media investment.
stories.citation: Omnicom now manages more than $70 billion in annual media investment

stories.explanation: Via Flywheel, première pratique mondiale de retail media.
stories.story_fr: Via Flywheel, Omnicom gère plus de 10 Mds$ d’investissement en retail media.
stories.story_en: Through Flywheel, Omnicom manages more than $10 billion in retail media investment.
stories.citation: managing more than $10 billion in retail media investment

stories.story_fr: Real iD reconnaît environ 2,6 milliards d’individus sur 36 marchés.
stories.story_en: Real iD recognizes approximately 2.6 billion individuals across 36 markets.
stories.citation: Real iD recognizes approximately 2.6 billion individuals across 36 markets

stories.explanation: Utilisateurs internes produisant des millions de générations par mois.
stories.story_fr: Plus de 70 000 collaborateurs d’Omnicom utilisent des outils d’IA générative.
stories.story_en: Over 70,000 Omnicom users now work with generative AI tools.
stories.citation: we've now mobilized over 70,000 users who collectively produce millions of generations every single month

stories.explanation: Augmentation récente décidée par le conseil.
stories.story_fr: Le conseil d’Omnicom a récemment relevé le dividende de 15 %.
stories.story_en: Omnicom's board recently raised the dividend by 15%.
stories.citation: which our board recently increased by 15%
